author: Christian Bouhon
name: Base workflow and filmic variants
description: Christian Bouhon's base workflow style and three filmic variants, 'Défaut' applies his complete starting workflow — exposure, denoising, lens correction, color calibration, local contrast, sharpening, filmic and color balance rgb — while 'Filmique Luminance', 'Filmique MaxRVB' and 'Filmique Préserver Chrominance Non' switch filmic's chrominance preservation between luminance Y, max RGB and none on top of it.
